assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson's voice is highly distinctive. She joins classical scholarship, lyric, essay, translation, drama and visual book form. Autobiography of Red recasts the Geryon myth as a verse novel, and Nox turns elegy into a physical, archival object. The formal achievement is sustained across several genres and rests on deep engagement with Greek and Latin literature, giving the work intellectual depth beyond novelty.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover renewing lyric and the essay through an encounter with antiquity and the limits of translation and elegy. It would name one writer and one body of work. The hybrid and visual forms and the translations should be treated as part of the achievement, not as peripheral to it.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre spans several decades and many books, with a consistent method that has kept evolving. Its influence on contemporary poetry and on hybrid forms is broad. Timing raises no concern.
uncertainties: Her work is deliberately hybrid and mixes genres, so a citation would need to define its scope carefully.
My knowledge of the full corpus, including the later performance and translation work, is partial and unverified.
Visual and typographic dimensions are hard to judge from description alone.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adonis has remade modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a critical dialogue with the classical tradition. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses are central in this respect. His essays on Arabic poetics and on tradition and modernity add intellectual depth. The formal and linguistic achievement is substantial and has been influential within Arabic literature.
assessment.attribution: A citation could rest on transforming the Arabic poetic idiom and on poetry as a form of inquiry into inheritance and exile. His essayistic and critical writing could be named alongside the poetry. One credited writer, with a clear body of work.
assessment.maturity: He has written across more than six decades, and his significance within Arabic poetry is well documented. His standing across generations of poets points to durability.
uncertainties: Much of the formal achievement depends on Arabic prosody and diction that translation conveys only partially.
My view of the English and French renderings is secondhand, and I have not independently verified translation quality.
His public and political positions are often discussed but are not literary-merit evidence and should not weigh on the assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cărtărescu writes visionary, densely patterned prose that turns memory, dream and the body into a metaphysical project. Blinding and Solenoid show unusual ambition in scale and imagery. The voice is highly distinctive and carries a lineage of European fantastic and visionary writing. His poetry adds to the range.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover an expansive imaginative cosmology rendered in Romanian prose and poetry. The proposed laureate is one writer. The central achievement is in the long novelistic works.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is substantial and has been developing for decades. Some of his major works have appeared in translation only recently, so reception is still unfolding.
uncertainties: The density and length of the major novels make their quality in translation hard to judge.
I cannot confirm how much of his poetry and essays is available in translation.
Repetition of motifs across the books may or may not be a limit on depth.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Can Xue offers a radical dreamlike narrative form that destabilizes psychology, space and causality. The voice is unmistakable and sets her apart within Chinese-language fiction. Her fiction has an affinity with Kafka and the experimental tradition, yet it is original in its logic and imagery. Her critical writing on Western and other literatures adds a further dimension.
assessment.attribution: A citation could name uncompromising experimental fiction that reconceives narrative in Chinese. Frontier and Love in the New Millennium are representative. One writer, a clear body of work.
assessment.maturity: She has produced a large body of work since the 1980s, with consistent method and some development. Durability is plausible but harder to judge than for writers with longer reception histories.
uncertainties: Translation coverage is partial and my knowledge of the untranslated corpus is limited.
Whether the repeated dream logic sustains depth across the full oeuvre, as opposed to the best-known works, is uncertain.
English renderings of her style may differ markedly from the Chinese originals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Zurita builds large poetic sequences, including Purgatory and Anteparadise, that turn collective suffering and the memory of dictatorship into poetic form. His landscape-scale and sky-writing interventions extend poetry beyond the page. The ambition and the moral and imaginative range are considerable, and the lyric core remains distinctive.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover poetry as collective memorial form and its engagement with Chilean history. One writer, with poetry as the primary genre.
assessment.maturity: The body of work spans several decades and keeps developing. Its significance in Latin American poetry is established, and it should endure.
uncertainties: Poetry in Spanish with a heavy historical context is difficult to judge through translation.
The weight of the non-textual interventions in a literary assessment is a matter for judgment.
My knowledge of his later volumes is incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Tawada writes in both Japanese and German and treats linguistic estrangement as a source of invention. The Emissary and Memoirs of a Polar Bear show inventive narrative with a light, defamiliarizing touch. The work spans fiction, poetry, essays and drama. Her interest in translation and the space between languages is intellectually serious.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover literature made in the space between two languages. One writer, and the bilingual corpus is part of the achievement.
assessment.maturity: She has a long and varied career with consistent concerns. The most important recent books are clearly strong, though some of the earlier work may be less familiar to me.
uncertainties: No single reader can assess both the Japanese and German texts easily, and translations flatten the linguistic play.
Whether the shorter forms carry the same weight as the major works is uncertain.
My knowledge of the German-language poetry and drama is limited.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Murnane writes radically inward fiction that builds systems of landscape, memory and mental images. The Plains and Border Districts show a distinctive voice and a rigorous, self-questioning prose. The formal discipline and the intellectual seriousness about fiction and memory are considerable.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover rigorous introspective fiction that investigates how images and memory shape a life. One writer, with a coherent body of work.
assessment.maturity: The work has developed over decades with great consistency, but the oeuvre is relatively small and the range narrow. Recognition has come late.
uncertainties: The narrowness of subject matter may limit significance for the breadth required by the will.
My knowledge of the later and shorter works is incomplete.
The English-language and Australian context makes direct comparison with writers from other traditions difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Wright writes large polyphonic narratives, including Carpentaria and The Swan Book, that rebuild the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. The scale and the formal energy are notable, and the work fits the committee's stated interest in perspectives beyond the established centers. That interest is not itself evidence of merit; the case rests on the voice and construction of the novels.
assessment.attribution: A citation could name a transformation of the novel through Indigenous Australian storytelling and political imagination. One writer; fiction and nonfiction are both part of the work.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is smaller than those of several other candidates, and its development is still under way. It is serious and significant, though the sustained-quality case is less settled.
uncertainties: Fewer major works make the depth-of-oeuvre judgment harder.
The extent to which the books depend on specific Waanyi and Aboriginal cultural contexts affects how well they travel in assessment.
My knowledge of her nonfiction is limited.
